Project Overview
Project Title: AI-Based Educational Content Viewer with Topic Summarization
This project is being carried out at Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU) as
part of the MCA 4th Semester Industrial Project. The project aims to develop an intelligent
educational content viewer that enables students to read PDF-based study materials through an
interactive digital interface and receive AI-generated summaries and learning assistance for
improved understanding.
The third month of the project focused on refining and optimizing the features developed in the
previous months, improving the accuracy of AI-generated outputs, performing system testing
with real educational PDFs, and preparing the project for final demonstration and evaluation.
Objectives of the Project
Develop an interactive and user-friendly PDF viewer for academic materials.
Implement page-wise and topic-wise AI-generated summaries.
Improve the accessibility and readability of educational PDF content.
Enable users to ask questions directly from the book content.
Enhance digital learning through intelligent features such as summaries, topic detection,
and video recommendations.
Optimize system performance and conduct comprehensive testing.

Organization Profile

Technical Development Details
1. AI Summarization Accuracy Improvements
Significant effort was invested in improving the quality of AI-generated summaries and answers.
The summarization pipeline was updated to handle longer and more complex academic texts
more effectively.
Improvements Made:
Refined text pre-processing steps to remove noise from extracted PDF content.
Improved chunking strategy for long documents to preserve semantic context.
Updated prompt logic for transformer-based model to generate more concise
summaries.
Validated summaries against original content for quality assurance.
2. Ask This Book Enhanced Accuracy
The question-answering feature was further improved to deliver more precise and contextually
relevant answers based on book content.
Enhancements:
Improved keyword extraction for better content matching.
Refined confidence scoring to reflect answer quality more accurately.
Added fallback logic to handle questions with limited matching content.
Improved suggested follow-up questions based on the current topic.

3. System Testing
Testing was conducted using real educational PDF documents from KKHSOU to evaluate the
system under realistic conditions.
Testing Areas:
PDF rendering accuracy across different document types and sizes.
Correctness and relevance of AI-generated summaries and answers.
Topic detection and video recommendation quality.
Performance and loading speed for large multi-page PDFs.
Mobile responsiveness and usability on small screens.
Feature functionality testing including bookmarks, highlights, and notes.
Challenges Faced
1. Summarization Quality on Dense Academic Text
AI summarization models sometimes produced less accurate summaries for highly technical
and dense academic content.
Resolution: Text chunking and pre-processing were improved, and prompts were refined to
guide the model toward more focused summaries.
2. Performance with Large PDF Files
Loading and rendering large PDF files with many pages caused noticeable delays in the viewer.
Resolution: Lazy loading was implemented so only the current and adjacent pages are rendered
at any given time, significantly reducing load time.
3. Ensuring Consistency Across Browsers
Some UI elements and PDF rendering behaviors differed slightly across different web browsers.
Resolution: Cross-browser testing was conducted and CSS and JavaScript adjustments were
made to ensure consistent behavior.
